propositions: read-only derivations over the durable ticket event store must compute attempts-per-ticket, first-pass verification rate, rework at 7/30 days, reopen-recovery, and revert-linked recovery from raw events and compiled state using hybrid approach

attempts_per_ticket and rework_within_days metrics require scanning raw event files sorted chronologically via event_sort_key with compaction-retired events included, while first_pass_rate and revert_recovery use compiled terminal state from reduce_ticket

metrics reading raw events must reuse existing reducer helpers (event_sort_key, is_active_event, RETIRED_SUFFIX) to sort, filter retired events, and skip SNAPSHOT files rather than reinventing file-handling logic
revert_recovery must filter reverts by target_event_type to count only substantive reverts (STATUS or COMMITS), excluding COMMENT and LINK reverts
metrics return None for empty ranges (Unavailable) and 0 for populated ranges with no qualifying events, with source='structural' and confidence='high' registered in the metrics registry
